# Municipal Ordinance No. 08, Series of 2017

**Reclassifying the Agricultural Lot of Hanson Yu Married to Divina Glinoga to a Commercial Land (Warehouse/Gasoline Station) at Barangay Poctol, Pitogo, Quezon with TCT T-360783 and Total Area of 2,318 Square Meters**

Resolution No. 141

## Summary

Reclassifies an agricultural lot owned by [[Hanson Yu]] (married to [[Divina Glinoga]]) to commercial land for use as a warehouse and gasoline station. The property is located in the built-up area of [[Barangay Poctol]], [[Municipality of Pitogo]], covered by TCT T-360783 with a total area of 2,318 square meters. Per RA 7160 Rule VII Art. 38 of the IRR, municipalities may reclassify agricultural lands through ordinance after public hearing when the land has substantially greater economic value for commercial use.

Motioned by [[Adam M. Forbes]], seconded by [[Felipe O. Livado]] and [[Timoteo F. Villaflor Jr.]]

## Key Provisions

- **Property Owner:** Hanson Yu, married to Divina Glinoga
- **Location:** Barangay Poctol, Pitogo, Quezon
- **Title:** TCT T-360783
- **Total Area:** 2,318 square meters
- **Reclassification:** Agricultural to Commercial (Warehouse/Gasoline Station)
- **Justification:** Land is in the built-up area and has substantially greater economic value for commercial use
- **Legal Basis for Reclassification:** Rule VII, Article 38, IRR of RA 7160

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Barangay Poctol]]
- [[Hanson Yu]] — property owner
- [[Divina Glinoga]] — spouse of property owner
